nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: Command-line entry point for the job agent: argparse-based CLI wiring discovery, ingestion, digest output, career fit, evidence management, and tailoring commands to the underlying services.

nodes.name: _load_profile
nodes.summary: Loads the user profile dict from config path.

nodes.name: _db_path
nodes.summary: Computes the SQLite database path from config.

nodes.name: _now_iso
nodes.summary: Current timestamp as ISO string.

nodes.name: _script_jobs
nodes.summary: Returns canned demo jobs when profiling via a script (--script-jobs flag).

nodes.name: cmd_scan
nodes.summary: Runs a source scan: execute run_sources over configured sources and print results.

nodes.name: cmd_discover
nodes.summary: Runs planned discovery: builds the query plan, executes discovery search/provider runs, persists candidates, and prints a digest.

nodes.name: cmd_profile
nodes.summary: Shows the active user profile.

nodes.name: cmd_sources
nodes.summary: Lists configured and probed job sources with health.

nodes.name: _sources_check
nodes.summary: Probes source health for each configured provider.

nodes.name: _source_probe_url
nodes.summary: Probes a single source URL for reachability.

nodes.name: cmd_jobs
nodes.summary: Lists stored jobs with status filter and optional match details.

nodes.name: cmd_digest
nodes.summary: Writes the latest matches digest to the configured output directory.

nodes.name: cmd_stats
nodes.summary: Prints per-source and per-method job counts.

nodes.name: cmd_decision
nodes.summary: Records a job application decision (interview/applied/rejected).

nodes.name: cmd_fit
nodes.summary: Calculates and stores career fit for a job: current-fit vs career-upside with evidence gaps.

nodes.name: _load_career_profile
nodes.summary: Loads the career knowledge profile.

nodes.name: _get_existing_evidence
nodes.summary: Loads existing evidence statements for a job/role

nodes.name: cmd_career_documents_ingest
nodes.summary: Ingests a career document (e.g. CV) and reconciles claims into evidence.

nodes.name: cmd_career_documents_list
nodes.summary: Lists ingested career documents.

nodes.name: cmd_career_evidence_list
nodes.summary: Lists stored career evidence entries.

nodes.name: cmd_career_artifacts_list
nodes.summary: Lists tailored career artifacts with status.

nodes.name: cmd_career_artifacts_show
nodes.summary: Shows the content or diff of one career artifact.

nodes.name: cmd_career_artifacts_diff
nodes.summary: Diffs two artifact versions and prints the changes.

nodes.name: cmd_tailor
nodes.summary: Runs the tailoring flow for a job: ensures evidence, builds plan, tailors artifact, and stores exposed artifacts.

nodes.name: _parent_database_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the parent project database path upward from the current dir.

nodes.name: _career_narrative
nodes.summary: Builds a condensed narrative of the career profile for the tailoring prompt.

nodes.name: build_parser
nodes.summary: Constructs the full argparse subcommand tree.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Script entry point: parses args and dispatches.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: CLI runner: configure logging, parse args, dispatch subcommand, handle errors.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic configuration model tree for the job agent: salary policy, scanning/search/ranking settings, LLM and digest settings, discovery pacing/budgets, career knowledge settings, and safety-checked Config loading with env overrides.

nodes.name: load_config
nodes.summary: Loads and safety-checks the config file, applying env overrides.

nodes.name: default_config
nodes.summary: Returns the built-in default configuration dict.

nodes.name: report.py
nodes.summary: Report writers: Markdown match listing, per-run digest files, and JSON serialization of matched jobs with salary lines and cleaned descriptions.

nodes.name: _clean_description
nodes.summary: Collapses whitespace in a job description.

nodes.name: write_markdown
nodes.summary: Writes matches as a Markdown file.
